note: Cross-family independence is the mechanism behind the panel gate and behind Lead and judge selection. Until this file existed the partition was a naming convention nobody could check, so `arena_judge_family_conflict` and the reviewer order rested on a mapping nothing pinned. A family is a property of the model, not of the harness that serves it — `cursor/` serves Grok, Kimi and Muse — so the partition is keyed by model id, and a model it does not name belongs to no declared family. Nor is a family a seat label: a model sits in its own model line's family, never in another vendor's to fill a seat.

families.note: Codex is the same family as GPT: a Codex-authored artifact reviewed by GPT would not be cross-family.
